BiblicalUsage: Maasai was a priest, the son of Adiel, named in the genealogy of those who dwelt in Jerusalem after the return from exile. His line runs back through Jahzerah and Meshullam to Immer, and his name stands in the record of the priests who served in the restored city.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Maasai's name is kept because God counts His priests, and the men who served in the restored temple were not forgotten.
